recipes.name: Garlic Shrimp Mac and Cheese (Prawns)
ingredients: 250 g / 8 oz elbow macaroni (, uncooked (2.5 cups))
1 1/2 cups cheese ((Cheddar, gruyere, or other), freshly grated (Note 3))
instructions: Breadcrumb Topping - Mix the ingredients together.

Partially cook shrimp / prawns Heat oil and melt 1 tbsp butter in a large, deep skillet or heatproof pot on the stove over high heat. Add shrimp (prawns), sprinkle with pepper, then cook for 1 minute. Add garlic and cook for another minute until the shrimp has changed colour but not fully cooked. Transfer to bowl.

Make Mac & Cheese Sauce - Turn heat down to medium. Melt remaining butter. Add flour and cook for 1 minute. Pour milk in slowly, stirring as you go. Once incorporated and lump free (use whisk if needed), stir in Seasonings, then water.
Cook macaroni - Once the liquid is hot, add macaroni. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring regularly, until macaroni is almost cooked through, then take it off the stove.

Stir in cheese and shrimp/prawns Add cheeses and stir through, then add shrimp. Taste for salt - tweak if needed. It should be saucy (see video) - it gets absorbed. Should still be saucy at this stage - sauce gets absorbed/thickens more in next step.
Sprinkle and broil/grill - Sprinkle over breadcrumbs, then place under the hot grill for just 2 - 3 minutes until the top is golden.
Serve - Sprinkle with parsley if desired and served immediately!

page_recipe_notes: Recipe Notes: 1. Prawns/shrimp: I use frozen for convenience. Thaw completely and pat off excess water with paper towels before using. Use large ones so they don’t cook through too fast. 2. Milk: full fat preferred but low fat is ok 3. Cheese: FRESHLY GRATED is essential for silky cheese sauce. Pre-grated packet cheese contains anti-caking agents which can cause the sauce to go powdery. Both cheeses can be swapped out for your choice of melting cheese, this is the combination I favour. I usually use cheddar or gruyere for flavour. And mozzarella for cheesiness and richness but with a less intense flavour. In the video, the orange cheese is Red Leicester which is a UK sharp cheddar. 4. Make ahead / storage: Best to make this using my Baked Mac and Cheese recipe which is more suited to making ahead (directions in note 4). Amend recipe as follows – Follow Note 4 Make Ahead directions in the Baked Mac and Cheese recipe. Toss shrimp/prawns with olive oil, pepper and garlic. Mix sauce, pasta and shrimp, pour into baking dish, proceed with recipe. 5. Nutrition per serving.
